attackers_goals: Obtain and abuse credentials of cloud accounts.
description: Cloud identity activity detected from distant geographic regions within an short time window. This suggests unauthorized use of credentials, possibly indicating a compromised account.
investigative_actions: Verify if the identity's credentials have been compromised. Examine the recent activity of the identity in question.
name: Impossible travel by a cloud identity
